title: iSCSI DTOE login transition can block a shared receive queue
query: iscsi dtoe window login shared queue

locator.excerpt: DTOE degraded network window update and login data shared queue

summary: With iSCSI DTOE enabled, a degraded network can delay advertised window updates. Data arriving before login completion can be rejected into a shared queue and prevent other connections from obtaining receive resources.
content: Observed history: DTOE offloads protocol work to the card. Under a network- unhealthy condition, the advertised win window update was delayed and the available window shrank. During the transition after the three-way handshake but before login completion, host data was sent to the protocol driver, rejected because login completion was false, and retained in a shared queue. Existing and new connections then could not obtain receive resources.
exclusions: a state transition and shared queue are not defects without lifecycle evidence
